commands.summary: Backend TypeScript build passed after adding summary.ts and the threadSummary/contactSummary/agentStatusSummary/pendingApprovals derived views plus their routes.
6 summarizer unit tests passed: derived fields, scoped vs full excerpts, advisory/no-authority envelope, and prompt-injection defanging.

Server integration tests passed, including the new scoped-summary test: operator full summary with excerpts, MCP-safe scoped summary with no excerpts/bodies, contact summary without phone numbers, scoped pending approvals without body/evidence, advisory agent status, and 401 after MCP token revoke.

MCP server tests passed: get_pending_approvals, get_contact_summary, get_thread_summary (always scope=agent), and get_agent_status return scoped advisory data; no dump-all tool is exposed; invalid ids are rejected before any request.
Full Electron validation passed: backend build, renderer build, renderer interactions, Node test bundle (incl. summary.test.js and server.test.js), and syntax checks.
RepoPact plus ForgeLink local validation passed for work-item, docs, evidence, and CHANGELOG updates.

environment.process_note: OCX-012/019/013: thread summaries are derived locally with a deterministic extractive pass (no model call, no schema change); cloud summarization stays opt-in and disabled. All thread content is treated as untrusted: excerpts are sanitized via sanitizeAgentText and labeled, summaries are advisory with authority 'none', and scoped agent/MCP variants omit message excerpts, bodies, and phone numbers. No dump-all-messages resource is exposed.
